stem: 6 workers can finish a job in 42 days. Working at the same rate, how many days would 7 workers need to finish the same job?

explanation.en: In 30 min the truck gets 35 km ahead. The car closes at 80 − 70 = 10 km/h: 35 ÷ 10 = 3.50 h. In that time the car covers 80 × 3.50 = 280 km. In a chase, the speeds SUBTRACT.

stem: Working alone, Ana can paint a fence in 13 hours and Ben can paint it in 7 hours. Working together at those rates, how many minutes will they take to paint the fence?

explanation.pt: Por hora, Ana faz 1/13 da cerca e Ben 1/7. Juntos: 1/13 + 1/7 = 20/91 por hora, então levam 91/20 h = 273 minutos. Somam-se as TAXAS, não os tempos; e a resposta sempre fica abaixo do tempo do mais rápido.
explanation.en: Per hour, Ana does 1/13 of the fence and Ben 1/7. Together: 1/13 + 1/7 = 20/91 per hour, so they take 91/20 h = 273 minutes. Add the RATES, not the times; and the answer is always below the faster person's time.

stem: A driver goes from town P to town Q, 360 km away, at 40 km/h and returns along the same road at 60 km/h. What is the average speed, in km/h, for the whole round trip?

explanation.pt: Velocidade média = distância total ÷ tempo total. Ida: 360 ÷ 40 = 9 h; volta: 360 ÷ 60 = 6 h. 720 km em 15 h = 48 km/h. Fica abaixo de 50 porque se passa MAIS tempo no trecho lento.
explanation.en: Average speed = total distance ÷ total time. Out: 360 ÷ 40 = 9 h; back: 360 ÷ 60 = 6 h. 720 km in 15 h = 48 km/h. It is below 50 because MORE time is spent on the slow leg.

stem: Pipe A can fill a tank in 4 hours and pipe B can fill it in 8 hours. A drain can empty the full tank in 24 hours. If the tank starts empty and all three are open, how many minutes does it take to fill the tank?

explanation.en: Per hour: +1/4 + 1/8 − 1/24 of the tank. The drain comes in with a MINUS sign. The time is the inverse of the rate: 3 h = 180 minutes. Ignoring the drain gives 160 — close, and wrong.
